sources.title: Quasi-particles in weak perturbations of non-interacting quantum lattice systems
sources.author: D. Yarotsky
sources.reading_depth: Definitions and Theorem 1, printed pages 2-3; Section 2 through Lemma 1 and equations (8), (14), (15), printed pages 6-9.
sources.matched_hypotheses: Possibly unbounded onsite self-adjoint operators, unique gap-one vacua, bounded finite-range interactions, whole-support empty boundary.
sources.missing: No numerical range-dependent fixed-point/commutator constants c1,c2 extracted; the paper explicitly allows changing c and epsilon conventions.

sources.title: Block-diagonalization of infinite-volume lattice Hamiltonians with unbounded interactions
sources.reading_depth: Lemma 2.8 and full proof; Theorem 2.10; Theorem 3.1 statement, induction setup and constant warning; Theorem 3.3 statement and closing proof.
sources.role: Primary comparison for higher-dimensional unbounded-domain Lie methods and support-dependent induction.
sources.missing: Full Theorem 3.1 induction and numerical td were not reconstructed. The O1 one-step proof is direct and imports no source threshold.

contribution: Explicit rooted ordered-word majorant with evaluated one-step remainder interval; standard finite-rank Lie method, no numerical gap claim.
